reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the date helpers, but re-derives the daily-skip-vs-move weekend decision that getUpcomingDates already makes instead of extracting it for both handlers.

duplication.why: The schedule-building, try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper and the 'daily skips weekends, otherwise getDateWithSkippedWeekend' decision are copied from getUpcomingDates in the same file.

placement.why: A schedule handler in server/schedules/app.ts registered next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates is where this tree puts such handlers, though the weekend decision belongs in shared/schedules.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: The handler is readable and its range-window logic is local and justified, but a future change to weekend handling now has to be made in a third place alongside getNextDate and getUpcomingDates.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared function encapsulates the full weekend decision in this tree; the handler uses the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper for moving.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts reshapes getUpcomingDates' separate daily branch and map into a nested skipWeekend/frequency==='daily' condition inside the loop, rather than sharing it.
